essence: The limited self arises through contracted consciousness and limited means, not through the true self's movement.
Determinative knowledge binds the transmigrator while the Lord wills subtle sounds into gross causes.
māyā binds by obscuring true nature until awakening
Dissolution of powers in the body is achieved by reverse meditation and contemplation.
Breath-merged channel-dissolution grounds the contemplations of conquest, isolation, and separation.
